name: Time Price Opportunity (TPO)
author: third-party
description: Market profile indicator that shows price distribution over time. Identifies the Point of Control (POC) — the price level with the most time spent — along with Value Area High (VAH) and Value Area Low (VAL). Used to confirm correction zones and entry timing in ICI setups.

outputs.name: POC
outputs.description: Point of Control — price level with the highest TPO count. Strongest support/resistance in the session.

outputs.name: VAH
outputs.description: Value Area High — upper boundary of the value area (70% of trading activity).

outputs.name: VAL
outputs.description: Value Area Low — lower boundary of the value area.

reading_guide.poc: POC is the highest probability zone for price reaction. In ICI setups, price touching POC inside a confluence zone triggers a Tier 1 entry.
reading_guide.value_area: If price is inside the value area during correction, the move is considered accepted/consolidated. POC touch within value area is the strongest signal.
reading_guide.poc_magnet: Price tends to return to POC after deviating — useful for both entry confirmation and TP planning.

inputs.note: Verify settings on chart. Common inputs: session type (daily/weekly), TPO period, value area percentage (default 70%)
